{{Top|leg}}
The '''Queen's Drawing Room''' in the [[Fountain Palace]] on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] was the room that led to the [[Royal Bedchamber]] through a door located at the back of the room. The room was opulent with an octagonal game table that rested in the center of the room, directly beneath a [[Kamarian]]-[[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] chandelier and was surrounded by eight flow-cushion chairs.<ref name="Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>
